entities.name: Mongol Yam (Postal Relay)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Genghis Khan established the Yam — a system of relay stations every 40 km across the largest empire in history. Riders changed horses at each station, carrying messages 300 km per day. Marco Polo marveled at it.
